typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCCOriginalBIC_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromTRADEKEYWORD
fromTRADEKEYWORD derive({Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID} = toString(LEGAL_ENTITY_ID),
		{Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE} = ATTRIBUTE_VALUE,
		{Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE} = ATTRIBUTE_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as string,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as string,
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_TYPE},
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID = {Copy of LEGAL_ENTITY_ID},
		ATTRIBUTE_VALUE = {Copy of ATTRIBUTE_VALUE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCCOriginalBIC_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsCCOriginalBIC
